title: A New Garden Section
text:
This month, our magazine has a new section about gardens. The article is written by Anna Brown, a teacher who loves plants. She shares simple tips for growing tomatoes at home.

Anna says you need only a sunny window and a small pot. She also says you should water the plants every morning. The article has photos of her garden on the last page.

questions.text: Who wrote the article about gardens?
When should you water the plants, according to Anna?
What can you infer about the article?
options: It is only for professional farmers
It is written for children only

questions.text: Why does the article include photos of Anna's garden?
options: To show that the tips work in a real garden
To show a new house for sale

vocabulary.definition: a piece of writing in a magazine or newspaper
a container used for growing plants

paragraph_translations: Bu ay dergimizin bahçelerle ilgili yeni bir bölümü var. Makaleyi, bitkileri seven bir öğretmen olan Anna Brown yazmış. Evde domates yetiştirmek için basit ipuçları paylaşıyor.

Anna, sadece güneşli bir pencereye ve küçük bir saksıya ihtiyacın olduğunu söylüyor. Ayrıca bitkileri her sabah sulaman gerektiğini de söylüyor. Makalenin son sayfasında onun bahçesinin fotoğrafları var.
